ns2:course.label: Leadership in a DRI Research Team Project
ns2:course.description: Design research is fundamentally interdisciplinary, often involving domain and process experts from a variety of fields. Students will gain hands-on experience with design research team leadership by learning how to define, staff, and manage a new collaborative research project or new stage of a continuing project. Special attention will be paid to the distinctive features of the design research process such as the extended period of ambiguity and methods for eliciting significant contributions from team members with varied domain and process expertise. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: ARTD 510. Enrollment in the MFA or PhD program in Design for Responsible Innovation or consent of instructor.
